$description: Tokens only the app uses (DTCG 2025.10), default theme: component aliases of the semantic roles and typography exceptions that no kit component takes. app.config.json writes them to design-system/tokens/app/, which the app imports and the npm package does not ship.

secondary-skeleton.$description: Skeleton bars and circles of the app (the kit skeletons take bg-surface-secondary). Component alias of bg-surface-secondary.

hover-icon-button.$description: Assistant-chat ghost icon button, hover fill. Component alias of bg-surface-hover.

body-sidebar.$description: Page background of the sidebar layout. Component alias of bg-body.

disabled-item.$description: Border of a disabled list item: workspace account item, process item. Component alias of border-surface-disabled.

hover-graph-node.$description: Permissions-graph node, hover border. Component alias of border-surface-hover.

default-graph-node.$description: Permissions graph: unselected node border, idle edge. Component alias of border-surface-default.

default-composer.$description: Assistant-chat composer border. Component alias of border-surface-default.

primary-terminal.$description: Gauge voting terminal border while voting. Component alias of border-accent-primary.

primary-cta.$description: Primary CTA card border. Component alias of border-accent-primary.

active-control.$description: Active border of a status control: pressed vote option (yes). Component alias of border-success-active.

primary-dispatch.$description: Border of the failed dispatch-simulation card. Component alias of border-critical-primary.

primary-chat-error.$description: Border of the assistant chat error box. Component alias of border-critical-primary.

default-wizard.$description: Wizard navigation step label. Component alias of text-surface-default.

tertiary-hint.$description: Faint hint text and list markers: onboarding hint, account and process item meta, chat list markers and composer hint. Component alias of text-surface-tertiary.

primary-detail.$description: Detail text one step lighter than primary: permissions summary, Safe proposal transaction details, permission chip. Component alias of text-surface-primary.

primary-panel-title.$description: Titles of the permissions-graph detail panels. Component alias of text-surface-primary.

selected-label.$description: Selected label kept neutral today: vote option toggle "on", navigation link of the current page. Component alias of text-surface-selected.

default-attachment.$description: Chat attachment remove button. Component alias of text-surface-default.

secondary-ticket.$description: Assistant-chat ticket card body text. Component alias of text-surface-secondary.

primary-message.$description: Critical message text: file-download dialog errors, dispatch simulation detail, chat character counter at its limit. Component alias of text-critical-primary.

primary-tx-error.$description: Error text of transaction dialogs: dispatch simulation title, Safe transaction errors. Component alias of text-critical-primary.

hover-attachment.$description: Chat attachment remove button, hover. Component alias of text-critical-hover.

selected-nav.$description: Navigation link icon, current page. Component alias of icon-accent-selected.

primary-chat.$description: Success status icon of the assistant-chat ticket card. Component alias of icon-success-primary.
Critical status icon of assistant-chat cards (attachment error, ticket failed). Component alias of icon-critical-primary.

supporting--compact-detail.$description: Secondary lines at 14 px with the default line height that keep one size (picker rows, file notes, permission details, sidebar account address)

control--compact-value.$description: Value shown inside a compact input (permission id input), fixed at 14 px

title-item--compact-card.$description: Item titles at 16/20 that keep one size (vote option cards, account and workspace items, welcome dialog items, simulation nodes)

body--demo-header.$description: Lead paragraph of the Aragon demo DAO page headers

stat--dao-header.$description: Stat figures of the Aragon demo DAO page headers

caption--dao-header-stat.$description: Stat labels and units of the Aragon demo DAO page headers

title-group--dao-header-action-compact.$description: Compact action titles of the partner DAO headers (Boundless, xMaquina)

title-group--dao-header-action.$description: Action titles of the partner DAO headers (Cryptex, xMaquina)

body--partner-header.$description: Partner DAO header lead paragraph (Boundless, Cryptex), at the sizes' default line heights

supporting--dao-header-action.$description: Action descriptions of the xMaquina DAO header

supporting--dao-header-action-compact.$description: Compact action descriptions of the partner DAO headers (Boundless, xMaquina)

body--xmaquina-header.$description: Lead paragraph of the xMaquina DAO page header

title-group--profile-card.$description: Name on profile cards and dialogs (Aragon profile, user dialog, simulation summary), fixed at the desktop size

control-sm--framework-leading.$description: Small controls at 14 px with the default line height (sidebar footer links, chat input and suggestions)

caption--unstepped.$description: Small print that keeps the phone size on desktop, with the default line height (chart axes, badges, graph and column labels, raw data, chat metadata, the sidebar footer)

title-page--wizard-nav.$description: Wizard name in the wizard navigation bar (names the flow the person is in)

control--workspace-switcher.$description: Workspace name in the workspace switcher, at the sizes' default line heights

body-compact--dialog-lead.$description: Lead sentence of the connect-wallet dialog, at the group-title size

body-compact--dialog-note.$description: Notes inside dialogs at one size with the tight line height (connect wallet, dispatch simulation errors)

title-group--profile-card-address.$description: Address standing in for the name on the user dialog, with the default line height

label--router.$description: Router address field label in Capital Flow, fixed at the desktop size

supporting--cryptex-header.$description: Cryptex DAO header action description (snug line height)

title-group--compact.$description: Group titles at 16/20 that keep one size (autocomplete menu groups, alert cards in dialogs)

title-group--wizard-intro.$description: Intro heading of the governance stages step in Create DAO

title-item--stage-card.$description: Stage names on the governance stage cards of Create DAO

body--framework-leading.$description: Body text left at the sizes' default line heights (page header descriptions, onboarding text)

body--explore-hero.$description: Lead line of the Explore hero, under the display statement

body-compact--transaction-review.$description: Text of the Safe transaction review and the transaction status container, left at the sizes' default line heights

supporting--framework-leading-large.$description: Secondary values at the item-title size left at the default line heights (gauge rows, contract cards, policy details)

title-item--document-default.$description: Item titles at 16 px with line height 1.5 that keep one size (allowed actions, vote dialog items)

supporting--column-heading.$description: Column headings of the gauge list, semibold through type-strong, with letter spacing

caption--column-heading.$description: Uppercase inline column labels of gauge list rows on phones, semibold through type-strong, with tracking

stat--chart.$description: Figure in a chart tooltip (exit queue fee chart), semibold through type-strong

stat--voting-terminal.$description: Figures of the gauge voting terminal

caption--voting-terminal.$description: Labels of the gauge voting terminal figures

supporting--sm-step-value.$description: Values that step up at the sm breakpoint, not md (campaign stat values); with supporting--sm-step-value-wide

supporting--indicator-xs.$description: The extra-small size of the DAO target indicator

caption--input-hint.$description: Hints attached to inputs at 12 px with the tight line height (keyboard shortcut chip, number input limit)

title-item--chat.$description: Request titles in the assistant chat history

caption--chat-note.$description: Notes and disclaimers in the assistant chat at 12 px with the body line height

title-page--chat-markdown.$description: Markdown h1 in the assistant chat (semibold through type-strong)

title-section--chat-markdown.$description: Markdown h2 in the assistant chat (semibold through type-strong)

title-group--chat-markdown.$description: Markdown h3 in the assistant chat (semibold through type-strong)

title-item--chat-markdown.$description: Markdown h4 in the assistant chat

supporting--chat-markdown.$description: Markdown h5 in the assistant chat (semibold through type-strong)

control-sm--chat.$description: Small text buttons in the assistant chat at 12 px

body-compact--chat-message.$description: Assistant chat message text and its markdown paragraphs and list items (relaxed line height)

title-section--network-groups.$description: Network group headings in the Create-DAO network step, at the item-title (h4) size

title-page--gate-prompt.$description: Workspace gate prompt heading (the page's h1) at the group-title (h3) size

title-section--explore.$description: Section titles on the Explore page at the page-title (h1) size

title-page--onboarding.$description: Dashboard onboarding greeting, two sizes above the page title

stat--stat-card.$description: Stat card figure at the group-title (h3) size

title-group--cta-card.$description: Call-to-action card title at the page-title (h1) size

title-group--cta-card-compact.$description: Compact call-to-action card title at the section-title (h2) size

title-group--small-panel.$description: Panel and card titles at the item-title size (assistant chat header, cards inside dialogs)

title-section--chat-empty-state.$description: Assistant chat welcome title (the chat's empty state) at the group-title (h3) size

inset-page.$description: Page gutters and the page block padding: container, page main and content, page header, footer, top bars.

gap-section-stepped.$description: Between sections that space out on desktop: wizard steps, settings forms, governance setup sections.

gap-layout.$description: Between page columns (main and aside) and the top-level blocks of a landing page.

inset-nav.$description: Navigation chrome: padding of the app shell around the navigation: the sidebar panel, the top and mobile header bars, the mobile nav menu.

row.$description: Minimum height of a clickable list row that is not an item with padding (account and workspace selector rows).
